create_Categorical_distribution: create a categorical distribution from probs or logits tensor for sampling integer outcomes
sample_Categorical: sample from a categorical distribution with optional sample_shape to generate integer tensors
compute_Categorical_log_prob: compute log probability of given values under a categorical distribution
compute_Categorical_entropy: compute the entropy of a categorical distribution from its probs or logits
get_Categorical_mode: get the mode (most likely outcome) of a categorical distribution via argmax of probs
